body:
Found while checking the consistency pass in a browser: /list/<id>/properties opened
directly (a reload, a bookmark, a deep link) redirects to the overview, because
ListPropsPage navigates away when the list is not in sync state yet — which it
never is on the first render of a cold load. The same bug the All items screen had
until T-146, fixed there by waiting for the first sync instead of redirecting.
title: web: opening list settings by link or reload bounces to the overview
